```{r functions}
transposePCA <- function(data){
rownames(data) <- data[[1]]

data <- data[, -1]

data <- t(data)

return(data)
}

#transposing

gemma_objs <- ls(pattern = "_gemma")
gemma_objs <- gemma_objs[sapply(gemma_objs, function(x) is.data.frame(get(x)))]

for (obj_name in gemma_objs) {
  df <- get(obj_name)
  df <- transposePCA(df)
  assign(obj_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

author_objs <- ls(pattern = "_author")
author_objs <- author_objs[sapply(author_objs, function(x) is.data.frame(get(x)))]

for (obj_name in author_objs) {
  df <- get(obj_name)
  df <- transposePCA(df)
  assign(obj_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

#plotting

pcaPlotOld <- function(expr_data, color_columns, plotTitle) {
  # Match samples
  rownames(metadata) <- metadata[["sample_name"]]
  common_samples <- intersect(rownames(expr_data), rownames(metadata))
  expr_data <- expr_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  metadata <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]


  Library_size <- rowSums(expr_data)

    expr_data <- log2(expr_data + 1)

  # Remove zero-variance genes
  gene_sds <- apply(expr_data, 2, sd)
  expr_data <- expr_data[, gene_sds > 0, drop = FALSE]

  # PCA
  pca_res <- prcomp(expr_data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
  pca_df$Sample <- rownames(pca_df)
  pca_df$Library_size <- Library_size[rownames(pca_df)]

  # Add metadata
  pca_df <- cbind(pca_df, metadata[rownames(pca_df), , drop = FALSE])

  # Generate plots for each color column
  plots <- lapply(color_columns, function(col) {
    is_continuous <- is.numeric(pca_df[[col]])
    p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(color = col,
           x = "PC1", y = "PC2")
    if (is_continuous) {
      p <- p + scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }
    return(p)
  })

  # Combine all plots into one image
  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots) + 
    plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(title = plotTitle)

  return(lplot = combined_plot)
  
}

cleanup <- function(expr_data) {
  
  expr_data_name <- deparse(substitute(expr_data))
  cleaned_name <- paste0(expr_data_name, "_clean")

  
  rownames(metadata) <- metadata[["sample_name"]]
  common_samples <- intersect(rownames(expr_data), rownames(metadata))
  expr_matched <- expr_data[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]
  metadata_matched <- metadata[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

  # Library size (total counts per sample)
  Library_size <- rowSums(expr_matched)

  # Log2 transform
  expr_log <- log2(expr_matched + 1)

  # Remove zero-variance genes
  gene_sds <- apply(expr_log, 2, sd)
  expr_filtered <- expr_log[, gene_sds > 0, drop = FALSE]

  # Return all relevant data in a structured object
  cleaned_obj <- list(
    expr_raw = expr_matched,
    expr_log = expr_log,
    expr_filtered = expr_filtered,
    metadata = metadata_matched,
    Library_size = Library_size,
    sample_ids = common_samples
  )
  class(cleaned_obj) <- "CleanedExprData"
assign(cleaned_name, cleaned_obj, envir = parent.frame())
  return(invisible(cleaned_obj))
}

runPCA <- function(cleaned_data) {

  expr_filtered <- cleaned_data$expr_filtered
  metadata <- cleaned_data$metadata
  Library_size <- cleaned_data$Library_size

  pca_result <- prcomp(expr_filtered, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
  pca_scores$Sample <- rownames(pca_scores)
  pca_scores$Library_size <- Library_size[rownames(pca_scores)]

  pca_scores <- cbind(pca_scores, metadata[rownames(pca_scores), , drop = FALSE])

  pca_output <- list(
    pca_scores = pca_scores,         
    pca_model = pca_result,          
    rotation = pca_result$rotation,  
    sdev = pca_result$sdev,          
    var_explained = pca_result$sdev^2 / sum(pca_result$sdev^2) 
  )
  class(pca_output) <- "PCAResult"

  return(pca_output)
}

pcaPlot <- function(pca_result, plotTitle) {

  pca_df <- pca_result$pca_scores

  plots <- lapply(c("Age_death", "Biological_Sex", "Ancestry", "Disorder", "Cohort", "Library_size"), function(col) {
    is_continuous <- is.numeric(pca_df[[col]])
    p <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 1) +
      theme(element_text(size = 3)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(color = col, x = "PC1", y = "PC2")

    if (is_continuous) {
      p <- p + scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red")
    } else {
      p <- p + scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")
    }

    return(p)
  })

  combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plots) +
    plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
    plot_annotation(title = plotTitle)

  return(combined_plot)
}
```
